items.note: 12-week quasi-experiment with 240 pre-service teachers using AI-assisted instructional design tools, scored on fluency, flexibility, originality, elaboration, overall creativity and design quality; the abstract does not describe a comparison group clearly (may be pre-post only), and the reported statistics look unusual, so check the full text.

CHI 2025 system paper (ProductMeta, a multimodal-LLM tool for metaphorical product design) whose user studies report more diverse and relevant ideas; the abstract does not state a comparison condition or sample size, so it may be system_paper_no_comparison.

30 participants did conceptual design in human-LLM (ChatGPT) versus human-human groups; outputs did not differ significantly, LLM groups finished faster; assignment method not stated and below the 50-person threshold.

Dyads worked with an AI whose viewpoint divergence was manipulated (high vs low) on scientific and everyday creativity tasks, with idea novelty and usefulness scored and fNIRS hyperscanning; abstract is in Chinese and states neither N nor random assignment (search notes say 89 dyads, 178 people, randomly assigned).
